title: Yoti ID and EasyID continue as normal after UK digital ID scheme scrapped
discussion_signal: Yoti frames digital identity as a choice-based trust and access layer that remains available through private-sector credentials even after a proposed government scheme was scrapped. The post emphasizes established use for age, right-to-work, and right-to-rent checks, making the market visible as an ecosystem of credentials, providers, and user choice rather than a single public system.
linked_research_question: When digital identity becomes an access layer, who controls trust, choice, interoperability, and recourse?
limits: Reported adoption figures are not independently verified here
LinkedIn reactions are not a representative public-opinion sample
